product.olivetti-m400-40.summary: The M400 variant with a 33 MHz 486DX and integrated coprocessor.
product.olivetti-m400-40.history: The Olivetti service guide documents M400-40 (the M400 variant with a 33 MHz 486DX and integrated coprocessor).
product.olivetti-m400-40.architecture: The board determines which peripheral combination needs verification. The guide identifies BA314 / BA315 · 82C452A · IDE.
product.olivetti-m400-40.firmware: The BIOS revision helps identify the service configuration. The guide records Flash · 2.08.
product.olivetti-m400-40.verified: The identity was checked in Olivetti documentation. The sheet remains under research.
product.olivetti-m400-40.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
product.olivetti-m400-40.guide: Olivetti, Personal Computer – Pocket Service Guide, 26-1.
